TOWERING ROLLER-COASTER — a big brick-built coaster with a Technic-beam support lattice, a SNOT-curved trans-clear-railed first-drop plunging from a tall lift-hill, a looping inversion built from curved-rail plates, slope-brick coaster-cars locked onto the track, the dominant centerpiece of the fairground.

GRAND FERRIS WHEEL — a tall brick Ferris wheel with a Technic-axle hub, radial spoke-beams of bar-and-clip connections, a ring of swinging gondola-cabin builds in candy-colored brick, trans-element bulb-strings outlining the full rim, towering as the unmistakable park centerpiece.

ORNATE CAROUSEL — a brick carousel under a scalloped peaked canopy of printed-tile and slope-bricks, a ring of brick-built horse and dragon mounts on barber-pole columns, gold-trim filigree of clip-and-bar detailing, a mirrored-tile center pillar, the vintage spinning centerpiece.

VERTICAL DROP-TOWER — a tall Technic-beam tower lattice mast with a ring of brick-built seat-harness modules at its crown, trans-element light-strips running the full column height, slope-brick base anchor blocks, the stark vertical centerpiece dominating the fairground skyline.

CHAIR-SWING RIDE — a brick swing-ride with a central rotating canopy-hub of stacked dish-elements and bracket arms, radiating link-chain hangers suspending individual seat-builds outward, a trans-element light-ring around the canopy edge, the airy spinning centerpiece.

HAUNTED MANSION — a lopsided brick haunted-mansion facade with crooked tower builds of offset-stacked bricks, boarded plate-covered windows, a creaky porch of dark-tan slope-bricks, trans-green plates glowing behind shuttered windows, the lurching dark centerpiece amid the bright park.

GIANT LOG-FLUME — a brick log-flume with a tall lift-chute of Technic-frame scaffolding, a trans-blue and trans-light-blue plate water-channel winding through stacked-rock brick scenery, hollow cylindrical log-car builds, a wide splashdown pool of blue plates at the base, the watery centerpiece.

BUMPER-CAR PAVILION — a brick bumper-car arena under a striped slope-brick canopy, a smooth tile-plate grid floor, a fleet of round brick bumper-car builds in bold primary colors with rubber-tire elements, trans-element ceiling-disc lights overhead, the chaotic-fun centerpiece.

PIRATE-SHIP SWING — a big brick galleon-build on a Technic-pivot arm, the ornate hull of dark-red and dark-tan bricks swinging up at a steep angle, gold-trim clip-bar railings, trans-orange lantern elements at the bow, the dramatic pendulum centerpiece.

SPINNING TEACUPS — a brick teacup ride with oversized pastel cup-builds of curved SNOT-brick walls on a rotating tile-plate platform, each cup seated on its own sub-spinner turntable, a central hub of stacked decorated round-plates, the whimsical low-profile centerpiece.

MIDWAY GAME-ROW — a row of brick carnival game-stalls under striped slope-brick canopies, each stall a distinct build for ring-toss, milk-bottle knockdown, and balloon-dart targets, a prize-wall of minifigure-scale plush-builds across the back, the bustling midway centerpiece.

WATER-SLIDE TOWER — a tall brick water-park tower with a Technic-frame stair-tower core, twin spiralling flumes of trans-blue and trans-light-blue plates twisting from the summit to wide splash-pool bases, the towering wet centerpiece of the fairground.

TILT-A-WHIRL PLATFORM — a low brick tilt-a-whirl with a wavy undulating base of curved-slope bricks, a set of enclosed pod-builds on pivot-pin mounts arranged around a central Technic-gear hub, scalloped canopy trim of printed tiles, the spinning-and-tilting centerpiece.

MONORAIL STATION — a sleek brick monorail station with a Technic-beam elevated guideway, a curved platform canopy of long slope-brick spans, a streamlined trans-clear-windshield monorail-car build docked at the platform, clip-and-bar signage columns, the transit centerpiece linking the park.

FAIRGROUND MIXER RIDE — a brick mixer-ride with a Technic-arm assembly holding four rotating gondola-cluster builds, each cluster a ring of open seat-bricks on a secondary turntable, a central decorated pillar hub, the multi-axis spinning centerpiece of the fairground.

MINI-GOLF WINDMILL — a full-scale brick mini-golf windmill obstacle with a whitewashed-brick tower body, four rotating sail-arms of flat-plate and bar construction on a Technic-axle mount, a red-slope-brick peaked cap, arched brick tunnel through the base, the whirling course centerpiece.

BIG-TOP CIRCUS TENT — a massive brick circus big-top with a peaked trans-yellow-striped slope-brick canopy supported on Technic-pole columns, scalloped decorative brick valances, a wide arched entry build of round-brick columns, the grand tent-form centerpiece anchoring the fairground.

ARCADE HALL — a wide brick arcade-hall building with a bold slope-brick facade, rows of brick-built cabinet-builds visible through trans-clear-plate window walls, a decorative printed-tile marquee above the entry arch, clip-bar sign elements along the roofline, the game-hall centerpiece.

SKY-WHEEL OBSERVATION RIDE — a tall brick sky-wheel with a wide Technic-spoke frame, large enclosed gondola-cabin builds in alternating colors hung on bracket pivots around the outer ring, a bold printed-tile center-disc hub, the towering slow-turning observation centerpiece.

FUN-HOUSE FACADE — a wide brick fun-house with a barrel-roll entry tunnel of curved-SNOT brick rings, a crooked mirror-gallery wing of offset-brick walls, a rotating floor-disc element at the entrance, printed-tile clown-face panels on the facade, the grinning interactive centerpiece.

HAUNTED DARK-RIDE — a brick haunted dark-ride building with a gothic slope-brick roofline, bat-wing SNOT-brick gable details, a Technic-rail track entering arched double doors, a string of trans-purple plate accents along the eave, the mysterious enclosed-ride centerpiece.

PARADE FLOAT CENTERPIECE — a grand brick parade-float build on a wide tile-plate rolling base, a layered castle-turret and flower-arch superstructure of SNOT-curved bricks, printed-tile banner panels, clip-bar flower-stem details, gold-trim round-plate medallions, the rolling ceremonial centerpiece.

SWINGING-RINGS RIDE — a brick rings-swing ride with a tall Technic-frame central mast, four hinged swing-arm brackets extending radially, each arm suspending a large open ring-seat build of bar-and-clip construction, a decorative round-plate top-disc, the swooping four-arm centerpiece.

RIVER-RAPIDS ATTRACTION — a brick river-rapids ride with a circular trans-blue plate channel of banked curve-bricks, round raft-builds of large-disc plate hulls carrying seat-brick modules, a central rock-island build of stacked irregular SNOT bricks, the swirling water-course centerpiece.

HELTER-SKELTER SLIDE TOWER — a tall brick helter-skelter with a cylindrical SNOT-brick tower body, an external spiral slide-chute of curved-plate sections wrapping from top to base, a peaked slope-brick cap with printed-tile pennants, a mat-launch platform at the summit, the classic fairground tower centerpiece.
